name: unsafe fn grow (& self , ptr : NonNull < u8 > , old_layout : Layout , new_layout : Layout ,) -> Result < NonNull < [u8] > , AllocError >
rule: For safety, `ptr` must denote a block currently allocated via this allocator: its starting address must have been returned by this allocator's `allocate`, `grow`, or `shrink`, and it must not subsequently have been deallocated by `deallocate` or by a `grow` or `shrink` call returning `Ok`. A `grow` or `shrink` call returning `Err` does not deallocate the block.
api: trait Allocator  : { unsafe fn grow (& self , ptr : core::ptr::non_null::NonNull < u8 > , old_layout : core::alloc::layout::Layout , new_layout : core::alloc::layout::Layout ,) -> core::result::Result < core::ptr::non_null::NonNull < [u8] > , core::alloc::AllocError > }
